system.specialAbility:
You become Trained in Animal Handling and Performance, and you become Trained in a relevant Lore of your choice.

Example Lores include Animal Training Lore, Circus Lore, Falconry Lore.
system.description: You taught animals to work beside people, shaping patient practice into dependable habits. You learned how to hold an animal's attention even when a crowd or sudden noise threatened to break it.
